mapper.select: SELECT b.order_id, b.user_id, b.event_id, b.booking_status, b.created_at, t.ticket_id, t.order_id AS ticket_order_id, t.event_id AS ticket_event_id, t.seat_identifier, t.ticket_price, t.ticket_type FROM tb_bookings b LEFT JOIN tb_tickets t ON b.order_id = t.order_id WHERE b.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT ticket_id AS ticketId, order_id AS orderId, event_id AS eventId, seat_identifier AS seatIdentifier, ticket_price AS ticketPrice, ticket_type AS ticketType FROM tb_tickets WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bookings (order_id, user_id, event_id, booking_status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{eventId}, #{bookingStatus})
INSERT INTO tb_tickets (ticket_id, order_id, event_id, seat_identifier, ticket_price, ticket_type) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{orderId}, #{eventId}, #{seatIdentifier}, #{ticketPrice}, #{ticketType})
